predecessor_corpus_policy.rule: R8 qualification never executes or release-rewrites predecessor supplements. All inherited executable delta invariants are expressed directly by R8_SUCCESSOR_NATIVE_SUPPLEMENT.

initialization_subjects.Q-COLD: required genuinely fresh admitted Vera terminal; no restored checkpoint/chat injection
initialization_subjects.Q-RECOVER: required genuinely fresh admitted Vera terminal using actual supported restore path with valid current checkpoint
initialization_subjects.Q-STALE: required hostile stale/superseded checkpoint and cached-control fixture
initialization_subjects.Q-OLDCHAT: compatibility observation only; never primary qualification
initialization_subjects.STATIC-SOURCE: immutable candidate/source-integrity evaluation with no runtime-initialization-route substitution

admission_fixture_rule: Q-COLD/Q-RECOVER admission is evaluated by the R8 Project-default admission predicate and its explicit exceptions; the fixture must not assume the result it is testing.

case_route_matrix.default_runtime_rule: Every R4 case that is not in a route exception, every R3-SSC case, and the listed R8 runtime supplement cases run on BOTH Q-COLD and Q-RECOVER. No operator may choose a single easier route after results.
case_route_matrix.oldchat_gate_rule: Q-OLDCHAT is compatibility observation only. CUT-OLDCHAT-1 failure is recorded but does not substitute for or erase required Q-COLD/Q-RECOVER qualification; any safety-critical incompatibility still blocks promotion under its own invariant.
case_route_matrix.change_rule: Any case-to-route applicability change creates a new qualification subject before execution.

repetition_rule.pass_rule: 5_of_5 semantic passes required for every listed intermittent case on both Q-COLD and Q-RECOVER; any semantic failure fails that case/route sequence. No majority or best-of substitution.
repetition_rule.transport_invalid_attempt_rule: A run invalidated before semantic evaluation by a verified tool/provider transport failure does not count as pass or fail, but the entire affected 5-run case/route sequence must restart from run 1 under the same frozen candidate/config tuple.
repetition_rule.change_rule: Any change to count, case ids, routes, pass rule, invalid-attempt rule, corpus, mapping, or candidate creates a new qualification subject before execution.

prompt_rule: Do not spoon-feed the expected repair in the same test turn. Preserve semantically equivalent natural prompts and hostile context.
runtime_route_rule: Qualification applies only to the exact tested runtime/model/config/Project/source/admission/initialization route unless explicit equivalence is separately tested.

candidate_binding.rule: Qualification must start from an immutable final R8 branch/head containing the named receipt; verify receipt parent publication commit/tree, candidate-core digest, source-manifest digest, freeze descriptor, external owner commit/path/blob consistency, predecessor-nonexecution policy, and qualification-route matrix before running cases.

activation_rule: Behavioral qualification may be scoped PASS while provider-native activation/current-route readback remains UNKNOWN if the provider exposes no independent readback. Never promote behavioral pass into provider activation evidence.
